status.description: done: the task is complete; partial: some of it; failed: it could not be done; needs_input: a question for the owner is in `question`.

summary.description: One paragraph for the study thread (at most 1500 characters).

report.description: The full report as the role prescribes, ending with the `## Stance` block (position/verdict/notes) or the `## Approaches` list when the brief asks for one.

artifacts.description: URLs or paths produced: the pull request first when there is one.

changes.description: Files changed, one path per entry.

validation.description: Validation commands run, with their result.

unresolved.description: What is left open; empty when status is done.

question.description: The question for the owner when status is needs_input.
